decisions.title: Extensions-first architecture
decisions.decision: Ship NewFang as project-local Pi extensions first; package second; SDK/RPC held in reserve.

decisions.title: Canonical repository state in .newfang/
decisions.decision: project.json is authoritative; events.jsonl is append-only history; PROJECT_STATUS.md is generated.

decisions.title: Thin Pi adapter, modular src/
decisions.decision: .pi/extensions/newfang.ts is a thin adapter; domain/state/tools/ui live in src/ and are Pi-free.

decisions.title: Roles as skills before runtime agents
decisions.decision: Permanent roles are product concepts/skills/prompts in the MVP, not runtime agents.

decisions.title: Sandboxing deferred and optional
decisions.decision: Sandboxing is optional and off by default; not an MVP prerequisite.

decisions.title: Focus is distinct from lifecycle status
decisions.decision: focusWorkItemId names the item receiving attention; it is not a status and does not imply in_progress.

decisions.title: The language model performs interpretation; NewFang owns preservation, schema...
decisions.decision: The language model performs interpretation; NewFang owns preservation, schemas, lifecycle, review, application, persistence, provenance, and resumability.

decisions.title: Model-generated interpretations are never applied to canonical project truth ...
decisions.decision: Model-generated interpretations are never applied to canonical project truth silently; the user reviews an understanding check first.

decisions.title: Schema version 3 is introduced with an explicit 2 -> 3 migration (inspect, --...
decisions.decision: Schema version 3 is introduced with an explicit 2 -> 3 migration (inspect, --apply, backup, atomic replace).

assumptions.statement: The Pi extension/TUI surfaces NewFang uses are stable at the pinned 0.82.0.
A single primary macOS/Apple Silicon machine is the initial target.
Repository-local orientation is sufficient for this phase; no external research is required.

risks.statement: Pi version churn during the 0.8x series could break the extension.
risks.mitigation: Pin exact pi@0.82.0; thin adapter boundary; repo-authoritative state.

risks.statement: Single-writer assumption for .newfang/ could race under concurrent writers.
risks.mitigation: Atomic temp+rename writes now; add locking before background/parallel execution.

risks.statement: Terminal UI overload as console modules grow.
risks.mitigation: Restrained ambient widget; console is read-mostly with progressive disclosure.
Progressive rigor; strict, compact operations model.

risks.statement: Interpretation of planning documents is nondeterministic, so the understanding check and human acceptance are the only guarantees that canonical truth is correct.
